notes.title: WonderLang Update - Japanese Version Improvements!
notes.content: [p][/p][p]We’ve been hard at work making WonderLang even better for Japanese learners, and we’re excited to share what’s new:[/p][p][/p][h3]1. Voice & Text Improvements[/h3][p]Even though our original voiceovers were created by a native Japanese speaker, some players noticed mispronunciations in certain lines. To make sure everything sounds natural, we brought in a second native freelancer to carefully check [i]every single dialogue line[/i].[/p][p]As a result, we’ve:[/p][list][*][p]Replaced [b]56 dialogue lines[/b] with corrected pronunciation.[/p][/*][*][p]Simplified some early-game text to make it more beginner-friendly.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted pacing in a few places so the audio feels smoother and easier to follow.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h3]2. New Keyboard Options[/h3][p]Japanese learners use very different input methods depending on their background, so we’ve added new keyboard layouts to make typing easier for everyone:[/p][list][*][p][b]Grouped Kana Keyboard[/b] - For beginners who struggled with the standard JIS layout, this version groups kana by sound, making it easier to find characters.[/p][/*][*][p][b]IME Kana Keyboard[/b] - Type in romaji, and the keyboard automatically converts your input into kana.[/p][/*][*][p][b]IME Kanji Keyboard[/b] (Kanji mode only) - Start with romaji, which converts to kana, and then press the space bar to turn kana into kanji directly.[/p][/*][/list][p]Different players have different play styles, so whether you’re a total beginner or already used to typing in Japanese, WonderLang now adapts to [i]you[/i].[/p][p][/p][h3]3. Bug Fixes[/h3][p]We’ve also squashed a lot of bugs over the past few weeks. If you ever encounter an issue, please let us know at [/p][p][url="https://contact@wonderlang.net"]contact@wonderlang.net[/url][/p][p] most reports are solved within 24 hours.[/p][h3]4. What’s Next[/h3][p]We’re now working on a [b]complete redesign of the UI and menus[/b]. In September, you’ll see:[/p][list][*][p]Cleaner, more responsive menus.[/p][/*][*][p]More customization options for both the game and menu appearance.[/p][/*][*][p]A greatly improved notepad.[/p][/*][*][p]A [b]toggle to switch between base and target language[/b] in all menus.[/p][/*][/list][p]This overhaul also prepares WonderLang for the arrival of new base languages (currently only English). WonderLang is not just for anglophones; expect new base languages [i]before the end of the year[/i]![/p][hr][/hr][p]✨ Thank you for playing and supporting WonderLang. We’re committed to making the game as fun, accessible, and adaptable as possible.[/p]

notes.title: Update August 20th 2025
notes.content:
- Added 2 keyboard styles for Japanese: IME for Kanjis and a new layout for the standard keyboard where letters are grouped by starting sound.
- Corrected various issues and missing translations accross all languages.

notes.title: Update July 8th 2025
notes.content:
- Corrected numerous instances of incorrect translations for homographs (words with the same spelling but different meanings) when looking up single words during dialogues in German, Spanish, and Italian.

- Fixed an issue that could block player movement when using mouse navigation to reach an out-of-bounds location.

notes.title: Hot Fix July 8th 2025
notes.content: - Fixed an issue that prevented the completion of Nicolau Mercardo's quest in the market about delivery dates (Portuguese only issue)

notes.title: Hot Fix July 4th 2025
notes.content:
- Fixed any issue that caused the word for fish to not be accepted in the postman's house in Korean
- Increased volume of the fairies challenges in Italian

notes.title: Hot Fix: August 2nd 2025
notes.content: - Fixed an issue that prevented finishing the postman's house bit in Japanese (with Kanji) mode.

notes.title: Update July 29th 2025
notes.content:
- Solved some instances of missing or wrong translations for the Spanish Version

- Added a Built-in Bug Report System:
A crash window will appear with the option to send us details.
You’ll also find a “Report a Bug” button on the title screen.
We promise to fix all reported issues within 24 hours (48 hours max).

notes.title: Update July 28th 2025
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that caused a crash with the error message “Uncaught TypeError Crash” when opening certain types of chests.
[*] Added a new option to adjust combat length and difficulty. You can now set a multiplier for enemy HP to increase or reduce the time spent on spaced-repetition-based combats.
[*] Added a microphone test option (Windows only). This new menu allows you to test and troubleshoot microphone issues related to the speech recognition feature.
[*] Slightly improved the accuracy of the speech recognition feature.
[/list]
